text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I visited the zoo together with 
Copano Rickey—

text_block_list.name: Recognizable Voice
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaah!? Please wait, Mr. Monkey!! That 
plushie is miiiiiine~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Is that voice... Fukukitaru-san!? I'm 
gonna go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
M-My 'Good Luck Penguin' belongs to the 
monkey now...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What rock-bottom unhappiness this is!! I 
bet my fortune will be—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I-It really is terrible luck~~~~~!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Heeey, Fukukitaru-san! Are you okay~?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah!! You're the Great Master Rickey!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Please save this Fuku! This hopelessly 
unlucky Fuku! I beg of you, save me with 
your Feng Shui, Masterrr!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see—and then, the plushie you won 
from the souvenir shop lottery got 
snatched away by a monkey, you say.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes... The lottery was sold out so I 
couldn't even try buying another plushie, 
leaving my mood and my luck at rock 
bottom...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I get the situation! I'll solve your 
problem in a Copa-flash☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru-san, your natal hexagram is 
'Qian', right! Looks like you're 
incompatible with earth energy today. 
Directions are northeast, yellow and brown 
colors, mountains, soil, stones, and—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This is definitely... northeast of the 
zoo! Plus, a monkey mountain with terrain, 
soil, and rocks, brown monkeys... 
Eeeeeek!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so scared! If we weaken the Earth 
Qi with Wood Qi, it'll fix the bad flow! 
At this zoo—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa! This right here is the bunny 
petting zoo corner☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Green trees to the east, and a rabbit 
symbolizing Wood Qi— you can absorb a ton 
of Wood Qi here!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah, this is sheer paradise...!! To put 
it in Doto-san's words, "Salvation was 
right here"...!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Fwaah~♪ That relaxing green space full of 
fluff was the absolute best~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
U-Um~... This properly stored up Wood Qi, 
right? My luck is bound to skyrocket, 
right??

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Of course it brings you closer to 
happiness! But feng shui is ultimately 
just a tool to attract good energy and 
harmonize your environment, you know~

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Happiness is something you seize with your 
own two hands! To truly be happy, it's 
crucial to forge ahead with a positive 
mindset!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I-I seeee...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, Fukukitaru-san, you can do 
it! You're always wishing for happiness 
with all your heart! I'll help you out 
too, so let's seize that happiness 
together!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... S-Hearing you say that, 
Rickey-san, makes me feel like things 
might just work out...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I guess... I'll just have to give up on 
getting the plushie, though.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, there are still things we can do! 
Right, Trainer?!
choice_data_list:
Let's try explaining the situation to the 
staff.

There might be souvenir shops other than 
this one.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's at least ask them about the 
plushie! It might just turn the tides in 
our favor!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
—I'm so sorry, little miss! We had the 
exact same plushie in the back, so I 
brought it over. Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"The thought of asking the staff 
completely slipped my mind! As expected of 
the great Rickey and company!"
choice_data_list: I'm just glad I could help.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So, what are you going to do from here, 
Fukukitaru-san?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I suppose so... I'm scared something else 
unlucky might happen, so maybe I should 
head home before anything does—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What?! That's such a waste~! Besides, 
since we ran into each other, let's hang 
out some more! It'll definitely be fun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Rickey-san...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"You're right... Stay positive, and seize 
your own happiness—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I'd love to join you...! There's 
still so much of the zoo we haven't seen, 
and since we're here, I want to enjoy it 
to the fullest...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit, Fukukitaru-san! All 
right, let's try this again—let's go!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the three of them toured the 
zoo and had a wonderful, happy time 
together.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"That's it! The souvenir shop's location 
should be on the park map, so—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... Ah, there's one more spot! 
Let's go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Found it...! There are still tons of 
prizes left!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to draw... I have the 
blessings of Feng Shui, but my innate luck 
is abysmal—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! Feng shui and all of us are on 
your side! Believe in yourself, take 
positive action, and you're sure to grab 
happiness!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
G-Great Master~!! Y-You're right... 
Staying positive— Matikanefukukitaru, 
moving out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: O-One more time!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Not yet...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: This time for sure—!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
W-We did it! I got the "Good Luck 
Penguin"!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
To seize happiness, your own positive 
mindset is what matters most— It's all 
thanks to Rickey-san's advice!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng Shui and I only pointed the way! The 
one who brought in all that happiness was 
you, Fukukitaru-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Copano Rickey's words, 
Matikanefukukitaru wore a proud, beaming 
expression.
